title: Ex-Rockstar Boss Dan Houser Won't Play GTA 6 for Creative Reasons
description: Former Rockstar Games co-boss Dan Houser reveals he doesn't play open-world games and won't play GTA 6, keeping his new Absurd Ventures projects creatively pure.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## A Surprising Stance from a Legendary Creator

For millions of gamers worldwide, Grand Theft Auto 6 is the most anticipated entertainment launch in history. Yet, one of the key masterminds behind the franchise's legendary status—former Rockstar Games co-boss and creative director Dan Houser—has revealed that he doesn't play a lot of open-world games. More surprisingly, **he doesn't plan on playing GTA 6 either**.

According to reports from IGN Games, this decision is not born out of indifference or animosity toward his former studio, but rather for a very deliberate and healthy creative reason.

### Protecting the Creative Vision at Absurd Ventures

Dan Houser is currently hard at work on two new game projects at his new enterprise, Absurd Ventures. To ensure that his creative vision remains entirely uncompromised and free from external biases, he chooses not to immerse himself in other open-world titles.

In the realm of AAA game development, avoiding accidental influence from contemporary projects is a common practice among visionary directors. By stepping away from the genre—including the masterpiece legacy he helped build—Houser is fiercely protecting the originality of his upcoming endeavors at Absurd Ventures.

### A New Chapter in Gaming

Houser's imprint on the industry is indelible. His narrative direction and world-building expertise shaped the modern landscape of open-world gaming through monumental titles like the GTA series and Red Dead Redemption.

While he will be sitting out on the experience of exploring Vice City in GTA 6, his dedication to forging entirely new paths at his new studio proves that his passion for creation remains as sharp as ever.

## Editor's Take
Dan Houser's refusal to play GTA 6 might sound shocking to passionate fans, but it highlights the mindset of a true auteur. By shielding his mind from outside influences, he is prioritizing the creative integrity of his new projects at Absurd Ventures. It's a bold and professional choice that ultimately benefits the future of gaming.
